name: for loops at the prompt
lines: for f in ~/forest/*; do echo $f; done
for x in 1 2; do echo $x | wc -c; done; echo $x
cd forest; for d in *; do ls $d; done
for x in a b; do echo $x; done > o; cat o; rm o
for x in a b; do echo $x; done | sort -r
for x in a; do ls; done | cat
for x in a; do nosuch; done 2>/dev/null; echo $?
bash -c 'for a in "$@"; do echo [$a]; done' n 'x y' z
bash -c 'for a; do echo [$a]; done' n p q
for y in; do echo no; done; echo $?
for 1 in a; do echo; done; echo $?

name: if and ! at the prompt
lines: if true; then echo t; fi
if false; then echo t; elif true; then echo e; else echo f; fi
if false; then echo t; else echo f; fi
if false; then echo t; fi; echo $?
if ls nope 2>/dev/null; then echo y; else echo n $?; fi
if ! false; then echo neg; fi

name: break and continue
lines: for i in 1 2; do for j in a b; do echo $i$j; continue 2; done; done
for i in 1 2; do for j in a b; do echo $i$j; break 2; done; done; echo $?
for i in 1 2; do echo $i; continue 9; echo no; done
for i in 1 2; do break 0; echo no; done; echo $?
for i in 1 2; do break x; echo no; done; echo no
for i in 1 2; do continue 1 2; echo no; done; echo no

name: syntax errors at the prompt
lines: echo a; for x in a; echo $x; done
for f in a b do echo $f; done
for x in a; do; echo; done
for x in a; do echo; done echo

name: exit in scripts
lines: bash -c 'for i in 1 2; do exit 3; done; echo no'; echo $?

name: test and [
lines: test -e readme.txt; echo $?; test -f forest; echo $?; [ -d forest ]; echo $?
[ -r /root/treasure.txt ]; echo $?; [ -w /etc/motd ]; echo $?; [ -x loops/loop.sh ]; echo $?; [ -x readme.txt ]; echo $?
[ -s readme.txt ]; echo $?; touch empty; [ -s empty ]; echo $?; rm empty; [ -e nope/x ]; echo $?
[ -z "" ]; echo $?; [ -n "$HOME" ]; echo $?; [ "$USER" = hero ]; echo $?; [ a != a ]; echo $?
test; echo $?; test ''; echo $?; test -n; echo $?; [ ! ]; echo $?; [ ! -e nope ]; echo $?
if [ -f loop.sh ]; then echo file; else echo none; fi
for f in *; do if [ -x $f ]; then echo $f; fi; done | head -3
